assets.scope: Native player body family (paper-doll), not a class or NPC; identity key descriptor.subrace x descriptor.sex -> moddable_tile per overload/mod/class/CheckerPlayerTokens.lua. Covers birth subrace Ogre at sex=Male (moddable_tile "ogre_#sex#"; native paper-doll art for this family is a taller 128x256 sheet, unlike every other family's 128x128). Runtime id player-ogre-male, exported to data/gfx/tokens/player-ogre-male.png.

references.note: Approved style anchor: reuse its steep overhead three-quarter camera, matte painted miniature finish, thin charcoal-brown disc and bronze-grey bevel at exactly that lightness. Do not copy its crouching combat pose, bald head, daggers, leather vest or sash; this token is a calm standing figure in plain traveller's clothes with no weapon.

Native unequipped paper-doll base body (skin-tone option 1 of several cosmetic choices; any option is equally native). Establishes body proportions and base skin/fur/bone value only: a towering, heavily muscled man, taller and far more massive than every other family in this set. Ignore its flat front-facing T-pose, flat top light and total nudity; the token uses the style reference's camera, disc and pose instead, and the figure must be dressed per the brief.

prompt_fields.subject: One towering, heavily muscled ogre man, standing in a calm neutral pose, weight even on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides with open hands, filling noticeably more of the disc's height than the other families' figures. Bald or close-cropped hair, a heavy jaw. Wears a simple large tunic or wrap belted at the waist over plain trousers, with bare feet or simple sandals.
prompt_fields.contrast: Must read apart from every other family at any size: (1) silhouette — the largest, most heavily built figure in the set, occupying visibly more of the disc height with thick limbs and a heavy torso, unmistakable even in outline alone; (2) value — a broad, simple value plane across the torso (large forms read as fewer, bigger shapes, not fine detail). Never shrink the figure to fit a normal human-sized silhouette; the scale difference is the primary identity cue for this family.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire figure on one disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, facing down-left or down-right. Head, hands and feet stay well inside the disc with a clear margin; the outer sixth of the disc radius stays bare base plate. Keep the head out of the upper-right rank corner and the upper-left interaction corner. No second figure, no mount, no companion, no ground clutter.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep tan to russet-brown weathered skin, dark hair or bald, a plain, heavy undyed or earth-toned wrap/tunic (oatmeal, hide-brown), plain trousers. No bright saturated dye, no metallic sheen, no jewellery.

Do not paint bare skin instead of fur, and do not add class equipment, goggles-as-accessory framing, or a snow/ice effect.
